The platelet target is printed as "above 50 per milliliter of blood" while the Table 1 platelet count is printed in ×10^(3)/uL.
The authors postulate prior dengue infection in Bangladesh and antibody-dependent enhancement after exposure to a different serotype, and a mosquito-borne spread to coworkers; these are hypotheses.

The rehabilitation-institute admission and discharge examinations are reported as two runs. Findings in the paragraph opened by the admission sentence and in the run opened by the discharge sentence take those times; the activities-of-daily-living sentences, the FIM score of 110/126 and the first MMSE score open a new paragraph before the discharge sentence and carry no time.
"On day 8" and the earlier "On day 2 post-admission to Hamad General Hospital" lack a stated anchor for day 8 in its own sentence.
"Bangladeshi" is a national descriptor recorded as documented; the source does not state race or ethnicity.
